name: Additional Parameters 26
definition: Specifies additional parameters to the message or transaction.

PreConfirmation.name: Pre Confirmation
PreConfirmation.definition: Specifies whether there exists a pre-confirmation.

PreviousPartialConfirmationIdentificatio.name: Previous Partial Confirmation Identification
PreviousPartialConfirmationIdentificatio.definition: Identification of the confirmation previously sent to confirm the partial settlement of a transaction.

PartialSettlementGuideline.definition: Partial settlement information only applies to markets where partial settlement is allowed.|The PartialSettlement field should be used as follows:|- with code PAIN in the first message(s) (there may be more than one) confirming the partial settlement of an instruction.|- with code PARC in the very last message sent to confirm the settlement of the remaining part.|For more details, see the relevant market practice document on www.smpg.info.
